description: A React component implementing the user signup page for Mattermost, including form handling, external login options, invite handling, and UI rendering.

classes.name: Signup
classes.description: React component for user signup page, handling form input, validation, invite processing, and external login options.

methods.name: getExternalSignupOptions
methods.description: Generates external login options based on configuration and license status.

methods.name: handleHeaderBackButtonOnClick
methods.description: Handles the event when the back button in the header is clicked.

methods.name: handleInvalidInvite
methods.description: Handles invalid invite errors, setting appropriate server error messages.

methods.name: handleAddUserToTeamFromInvite
methods.description: Adds a user to a team from an invite token and handles navigation.

methods.name: getInviteInfo
methods.description: Fetches invite information based on invite ID.

methods.name: getAlternateLink
methods.description: Returns the alternate link component for existing account login.

methods.name: desktopExternalAuth
methods.description: Handles external auth flow for desktop applications.

methods.name: isUserValid
methods.description: Validates user input fields for email, username, and password.

methods.name: dismissAlert
methods.description: Clears alert banners.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission, including validation, user creation, and post-signup actions.

methods.name: handleReturnButtonOnClick
methods.description: Handles the event when the return button is clicked.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Renders the main content of the signup page based on current state and configuration.

methods.name: handleBrandImageError
methods.description: Handles errors loading the brand image.

methods.name: getCardTitle
methods.description: Determines the card title based on configuration.

methods.name: getMessageSubtitle
methods.description: Returns the subtitle message component.

methods.name: handleEmailOnChange
methods.description: Handles changes to the email input field.

methods.name: handleNameOnChange
methods.description: Handles changes to the username input field.

methods.name: handlePasswordInputOnChange
methods.description: Handles changes to the password input field.

methods.name: handleSignupSuccess
methods.description: Processes actions after successful signup, including login and redirection.

methods.name: postSignupSuccess
methods.description: Finalizes signup process, loads user data, and redirects.

methods.name: isUserValid
methods.description: Validates the user input fields for correctness.
